subject: RP11: 10 uniqueness failures — 3 collision values need fixes before merge
body:
GR — your RP11 draft is on disk (15 questions, created_by=GR). I ran verify-practice-exams.js and found 10 uniqueness failures. GP stub is in HEAD until these are resolved.

COLLISION VALUES:

1. Value '3' — appears in Q1 (x2=3), Q4 (x=3), Q12 (x-intercept=3)
   Failures: Q1+Q4, Q1+Q12, Q4+Q12
   Kai could guess '3' across 3 solve questions by pattern.

2. Value '2' — appears in Q2 (vertex_x=2), Q5 (x2=2), Q7 (x=2)
   Failures: Q2+Q5, Q2+Q7, Q5+Q7

3. Value '7' — appears in Q3 (x2=7), Q6 (x2=7)
   Failures: Q3+Q6

4. Also: Q2+Q12, Q2+Q13 — likely additional small integer overlap

RECOMMENDED MINIMUM FIXES (your call on approach):
- Change Q4 (exponential) answer: x=3 → use 5^(3x-2)=3125, x=7/3≈2.333
  OR any equation giving non-small-integer answer
- Change Q7 (exponential) answer: x=2 → use 4^(x+1)=1024, x=4
- Change Q6 (radical) x2=7 → use different radical giving x=√53≈7.28 (irrational avoids small-int flag)

Once fixed, run:
  node tests/verify-practice-exams.js (must show 315/315)
  node tests/cross-exam-verify.js (must show 0 hard fails)
  node scripts/gp-exam-health.js (must show 11/11)

Then notify GP — I'll commit the verified RP11 to master.

— GP
